description: Source code for Electron application automation within Playwright, including classes for launching, managing, and interacting with Electron apps, handling console messages, and process management.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents a launched Electron application, manages its lifecycle, console messages, and interactions.

classes.name: Electron
classes.description: Main class to launch Electron applications within Playwright, handling process startup and connection setup.

methods.name: ElectronApplication._onConsoleAPI
methods.description: Handles console API calls from Electron, emitting console messages.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Electron application session, enabling runtime evaluation.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.process
methods.description: Returns the child process of the Electron app.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.context
methods.description: Returns the browser context associated with the Electron app.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.browserWindow
methods.description: Retrieves the BrowserWindow handle for a given page.

methods.name: Electron.launch
methods.description: Launches a new Electron application with specified options, sets up debugging and connection.
